title: Entitled Man Turns a Restaurant Complaint into Arrest
description:
Shaggie from Doobie Do was bummed his chicken wings got cancelled, so he staged a protest that ended with cops whacking his entitled butt. He stayed uncooperative all the way to the hospital and racked up charges from resisting arrest to trespassing. Meanwhile, another genius couldn’t pay for dinner, so he choked a cop instead, earning himself a buffet of charges including attempted h*micide and theft.
